ideas.pitch: A localized sustainability tracking tool that ingests municipal utility, supply chain, and transit logs to generate predictive corporate emission forecasts and live reduction dashboards.

ideas.title: MedFlow AI: Patient Triage & Healthcare Resource Analytics
